description.value:
Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +4, No levels in a class with Swordplay

Benefit: Select a Swordplay Form (Dark Sword, Destroy Sword, Holy Sword, or Universal). Select two basic swordskills, and ready one for use. Recover a swordskill with a full round action. Damage is determined as though your sword saint level equals half your character level; DC equals 10 + half character level + Cha modifier.

system.requirements: Base attack bonus +4, No levels in a class with Swordplay
